https://www.autocarindia.com/car-news/sk.text: Car News Follow us Skoda Slavia Monte Carlo edition gets new limited-run colours Despite the exclusivity of the new paint options, prices remain the same. 2 min read • 21 Jul '26 Glenn Noronha Skoda India has introduced two new limited-run colour options with the Slavia Monte Carlo Edition. The Czech carmaker says that only 200 units of the Slavia Monte Carlo will be produced in these colour options. Despite these exclusive new colours, prices remain unchanged, ranging from Rs 16.69 lakh to Rs 18.19 lakh. New colour options limited to 200 examples Available with both 1.0 and 1.5-litre turbo-petrol variants Skoda Slavia Monte Carlo limited-run colour details Dubbed Shimla Green and Steel Grey, both new paint options feature a black roof The two limited-run colour options on the Slavia Monte Carlo Edition are called Shimla Green and Steel Grey. Both have a dual-tone finish, with the roof finished in black. This increases the colour palette available for the Slavia to seven options, albeit for a limited time. The Slavia Monte Carlo is already offered in two monotone colours, namely Lava Blue and Deep Black, alongside three dual-tone shades with a black roof: Candy White, Brilliant Silver and Cherry Red. Based on the top-end Prestige trim, the Monte Carlo edition sits at the top of the Slavia line-up. It brings several cosmetic upgrades, some of which are also shared with the mid-level Sportline trim. For the exterior, these include dual-tone paint options, a blacked-out finish for the grille, bumper elements, logos, outside rearview mirrors and 16-inch alloy wheels, Monte Carlo branding on the front fenders, a smoked effect for the tail-lamps and a black boot-lip spoiler. On the inside, you get an all-black layout with red accents, a red theme for the digital driver’s display, red-and-black leatherette seats with Monte Carlo inscriptions, Monte Carlo-branded scuff plates, red stitching for the front door armrests and sporty metal pedals. Skoda Slavia Monte Carlo engine and gearbox options Two engines on offer with automatic gearboxes only The Monte Carlo Edition is offered with two direct-injection turbo-petrol engine options. There’s a 1.0-litre unit that develops 115hp and 178Nm of torque, paired with a 6-speed torque-converter automatic. The larger, more powerful 1.5-litre mill churns out 150hp and 250Nm of torque and is mated to a 7-speed DCT. All prices are ex-showroom, India. https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c980.text: Image source, Getty Images By Paweena Ninbut ,Â Thanyarat Doksone Â and Â Koh Ewe Published 7 August 2026, 09:54 BST Updated 3 hours ago At least seven people have been killed and 23 injured after a 14-year-old boy opened fire at his home and school on the outskirts of Thailand's capital, Bangkok. The gunman - a student at the Debsirin School in Nonthaburi - killed his grandparents and five teachers before taking his own life, Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul told reporters. The attacker still had "more than 30 bullets left" when he turned the gun on himself, Anutin added. Nine of the injured people remain in a critical condition, authorities say. The shooting - the second at a school in Thailand this year - has renewed pressure on the government for greater action on gun control. Police were deployed to the scene during the active shooting, which began just after 10:00 local time (03:00 GMT). National police chief police Gen Kittiratt Phanphet told reporters that forensic officers had found the gunman's shots were quite accurate, with several hitting vital spots on the body. The prime minister said the attack was "well prepared" with "clear steps and clear goals". A female seventh grader, still in school uniform, told the BBC she was standing in front of her teacher when the woman was shot. "She was talking to me when [the gunman] showed up and shot her," she said. "I couldn't see anything but a [cloud] of dust." Still in her uniform, with her mother by her side, she explained how the shooter stalked from room to room. "I had to climb over the school fence to escape with other friends." Her mother says the girl thought she might die. "[She said] 'I thought I'd never see you again'." Another student told Reuters news agency that he had thought the sound of gunshots were firecrackers going off. "There were many shots: bang bang bang. Then it went quiet. Then it started again." Students and school staff were seen fleeing from the scene, and those waiting outside the Debsirin School looked visibly distraught. Authorities warned people to stay away from the area and for those trapped in the building to hide and wait for rescuers. In a post on social media, the school later shared a call for blood donations. Other schools in the vicinity suspended classes so students could return home early. Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Police have been combing over the school for evidence I was standing in front of my teacher when she was shot, Thai pupil says Published 4 hours ago The attacker has not been publicly named, and police have not disclosed a motive. Investigations are continuing, with officers seen carrying away computer equipment and boxes from the home the shooter shared with his grandparents, who he shot dead before the school rampage. The attacker had lived with his grandparents as his parents were divorced. Both the father and the mother were called in for questioning at a local police station later on Friday. The Debsirin School, founded in Bangkok in 1885, is one of Thailand's top secondary schools with branches across the country. It counts many prominent Thai figures as its alumni, from diplomats and athletes to several prime ministers. Figure caption, Students shelter in classroom as gunshots heard The prime minister said the tragedy "shouldn't have happened", adding "this is why the government do not allow [citizens] to possess firearms". "I don't just feel sorry for the victims but I feel sorry that this happened. How can this happen in our country," Anutin said. Thailand has strict gun laws, which punishes the illegal possession of arms with up to 10 years in jail. Enforcement of these laws has been an issue - though police have made no suggestion the weapon used in this case, owned by the shooter's grandfather, was illegally obtained. The country has one of the highest rates of civilian gun ownership in South East Asia. It is estimated that about 40% of these guns are illegal. Friday's shooting immediately triggered calls from politicians for a review of the current gun laws. Anutin responded by pledging to introduce a new firearms control law. Under the proposed new legislation, there will be restrictions on members of the public carrying such weapons. "The new law will only allow government officials on duty to carry guns," Anutin said. He did not provide any specifics for the proposed legislation, including whether it would tighten gun ownership requirements. https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live.text: Hello and welcome to the US politics live blog. Democratic primaries for governor in Wisconsin and US senator in Minnesota will once again see left-wing candidates face off against more traditional ones. The party’s ideological rift, that has already been seen in contests across the States this year, shifts to the upper Midwest later today. In Wisconsin, state representative Francesca Hong, a self-described democratic socialist, is front-runner for the party’s nomination for governor in a swing state where winning the governor’s mansion is central to Democrats’ hopes for 2028 and beyond. In Minnesota, Peggy Flanagan is running for the nomination for an open Senate seat against centrist Democratic representative Angie Craig. Meanwhile, seven Minnesota Republicans are vying to face off against likely Democratic gubernatorial nominee senator Amy Klobuchar in November. The primaries come a week after Abdul El-Sayed narrowly defeated Haley Stevens in Michigan’s divisive and costly US Senate

https://telex.hu/belfold/2026/08/24/breu.text: Menü Kereső Breuer Péter Heti TV-jének is jutott pár százmilliónyi közpénz Sarka Kata és Rogán-Szendrei Cecília cégén keresztül Belföld Patakfalvi Dóra Állítsd be a Telexet megbízható forrásnak! Beállítom Breuer Péter Heti TV-jéhez két cégen keresztül is áramlottak állami hirdetési pénzek, a Sarka Kata és Rogán-Szendrei Cecília köreihez tartozó Digital Minds közreműködésével például kis híján 273 millió forint – tárta fel a HVG . Mindez a Rogán Antal vezette Miniszterelnöki Kabinetirodától kiperelt dokumentumokból derült ki, amelyeket az Átlátszó bárki számára elérhetővé tett. Breuer sokaknak a fideszes kormányinfókról lehet ismerős. A jellemzően pár százas vagy pár ezres nézettséggel rendelkező Heti TV képviseletében megjelenő Breuer ilyenkor sok esetben jobb pozícióból kérdezhetett, mint a vezető hírportálok. Lapunk 2021-es összesítése szerint a Heti TV a hatodik leghamarabb szót kapó médium volt, közvetlenül az RTL után, és ez a gyakorlat később sem sokat változott. Breuer korábban Orbán Viktor miniszterelnöki tolmácsaként dolgozott Izraelben, World B.P.I. Bt. nevű cége pedig 2018 és 2022 között több mint 20 millió forintért adott külpolitikai tanácsokat a Fidesz-frakciónak. Vagyis miközben a kormánypártnak dolgozott, újságíróként intézett kérdéseket a kormányhoz a kormányinfókon. Beruert 2022-ben Magyar Arany Érdemkeresztettel tüntették ki. A HVG szerint a Heti TV-re jutó kormányzati hirdetési pénz kisebb részét közvetlenül Breuer saját cége, a Breuer Press Production Kft. értékesítette, ami 2020 és 2024 között 119,8 millió forintnyi Heti TV-reklámidőt adott el 25 kormányzati kampányban. A kampányok között volt például a Covid-oltásról és a gondosóráról szóló kommunikáció, a brüsszeli szankcióról szóló nemzeti konzultáció, valamint a háborúval és inflációval kapcsolatos kormányzati üzenetek. A Heti TV-hez áramló összeg nagyobb részét, a 272,8 millió forintnyi összeget a Sarka Kata és Rogán-Szendrei Cecília köreihez tartozó Digital Minds értékesítette. Ennek része volt például a 2022-es „Büszke magyar zsidónak lenni” kampány 114,862 milliós és a 2023-as, azonos című kampány 71,208 milliós tétele. A Heti TV köréhez emellett a csatorna működését támogató Magyarországi Zsidó Közösségi Médiáért Alapítványon keresztül is jutott közpénz: az alapítvány 2024-ben 8 millió forint vissza nem térítendő támogatást kapott a Miniszterelnöki Kabinetirodától, korábban pedig három év alatt 17,5 millió forintot a Miniszterelnökség Városi Civil Alapjából. Sarka és Rogán-Szendrei Twn.hu nevű bulvároldalának mágikus sikertörténetéről és Rogán Antal minisztériumának brutálisan túlárazott hirdetéseiről ebben a cikkben írtunk részletesen .
